question: How should multi-channel cadences balance email, phone, LinkedIn, and video to maximize reply without destroying brand?
answer:
## Direct

Optimal multi-channel rhythm: **Email daily (Step 1) → Phone day 4 → LinkedIn day 7 → Video day 10 → Email step 2 day 14**. Spacing prevents fatigue, reinforces message.

## Detail

### Channel Sequence Logic

Channels have **different strengths**; sequencing matters:

| Channel | Strength | Weakness | Timing |
|---------|----------|----------|--------|
| Email | Scale (500+/week) | Filtered, low open rate (22-28%) | Day 1, 2, 3 |
| Phone | Synchronous, urgent | Low contact rate (8-12%), rep time-heavy | Day 4-5 (post-email) |
| LinkedIn | Warm touch, permission | Async, algorithm-dependent (10-20% inbox delivery) | Day 7-8 (after phone attempt) |
| Video | Personal, conversion | High friction (low send rate, ~2-5% of audience), time-intensive | Day 10+ (high-value only) |

### Multi-Channel Cadence Architecture

**Week 1 (Email focus)**
- Day 1: Email Step 1 (curiosity subject, no ask)
- Day 2: Email Step 1 variant (different subject line, same body)
- Day 3: Email Step 1 variant #3
- Day 4: **Phone attempt** (1 call, voicemail script, no recorded outreach)
- Day 5: LinkedIn connection (no message, just add)
- Day 7: **LinkedIn message** (reference Step 1 topic, genuine 2-3 sentence comment on post/profile)

**Week 2 (Escalation + Video)**
- Day 8: Email Step 2 ("following up on X")
- Day 10: **Async video** (Loom/BombBomb, 30-45 sec, personal reason to reach out, no hard ask)
- Day 12: LinkedIn follow-up (add value, share relevant article)
- Day 14: Email Step 3 (final, soft close)

### Reply Rate Multiplier by Channel Mix

**Single channel (email only)**
- Reply rate: **3-5%**
- Meeting rate: **0.5-1.2%**

**Dual channel (email + LinkedIn)**
- Reply rate: **5.5-7%** (+40% lift)
- Meeting rate: **1.2-2%** (+60% lift)
- Why: LinkedIn re-triggers email reads; message breakage drives curiosity

**Tri-channel (email + phone + LinkedIn)**
- Reply rate: **7-10%** (+70% lift)
- Meeting rate: **2-3.5%** (+140% lift)
- Why: Phone humanizes; LinkedIn validates legitimacy post-phone

**Quad-channel (+ video on high-intent)**
- Reply rate: **9-12%** (+90% lift, but video-only targets)
- Meeting rate: **3.5-5%** (+180% lift on high-intent segment)
- Note: Video ROI only hits **$8-12 CAC** when applied to **intent-scored top 20%** of list

### Fatigue & Brand Risk

- **Touchpoint saturation threshold**: **>6 async touches** (email/LinkedIn/video combined) in **<3 weeks** drops reply rate by **40%** and risks **"spam" perception**
- **Pavilion finding**: Brands sustain reply rates **>7%** when **spacing >2 days** between channel shifts
- **Phone + email same day**: **-35% reply rate** (appears desperate); separate by **≥3 days**
- **LinkedIn spam trap**: Generic **"Let's connect"** adds **0% value**. Only personalized **"I read your post on X"** avoids block risk

### Cadence Template (SaaStr-style)

```mermaid
gantt
    title Multi-Channel Cadence (14-day sequence)
    section Email
    Step 1 Var A: e1, 0, 1d
    Step 1 Var B: e2, 1d, 1d
    Step 1 Var C: e3, 2d, 1d
    Step 2 (follow): e4, 6d, 1d
    Step 3 (final): e5, 13d, 1d
    section Phone
    Call attempt: p1, 3d, 1d
    section LinkedIn
    Connection: ln1, 4d, 1d
    Message: ln2, 6d, 1d
    Follow-up: ln3, 11d, 1d
    section Video
    Async Loom: v1, 9d, 1d
```

Multi-channel **reply rate gains cap at 10-12%** due to list quality, not cadence depth. Past **6 touches**, marginal returns disappear. **Optimal strategy**: Run **tight email + phone + LinkedIn trio** for **2 weeks**, then evaluate **low-hanging reply** signals (unsubscribe-adjacent, multiple replies suggesting interest). **Video scales only on highest-intent segment**, not bulk list.
